title: Team operations
rules: Use packet-selected work and bounded status resources.
Respect leases, ownership, dependencies, and file claims.

sections.heading: Boards
sections.body: Read only the returned team-board, next-actions, review-queue, handoff, or fleet resource needed for the current decision.

sections.heading: Parallel work
sections.body: Use returned `parallel.*` actions. Sequential phases dispatch one task; parallel phases may dispatch independent, non-conflicting tasks.

sections.heading: Intelligence
sections.body: Use returned `intel.*` actions or targeted repo-map, diagnostics, dependency, test-impact, LSP, or DAP resources before broad prompt-side scans.
